about: Settings on a fresh Mac: the lassos it can talk to (production in use, a dev lasso on the tunnel), and the permission states: accessibility not asked; and which kinds of news may interrupt this Mac, from lasso's catalog (finished turns turned on here).

kinds.label: An agent is waiting on you
kinds.description: A question, an approval or a plan gate.

kinds.label: An agent finished a turn
kinds.description: Any agent that stops working with its turn done.

kinds.label: An agent pinged you
kinds.description: An agent's own message for you (lasso notify).

kinds.label: A bot replied
kinds.description: A bot finished a turn with something new to say.

kinds.label: lasso's own notices
kinds.description: Errors and results from lasso itself, like a theme a host would not take.
